messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Your Harlo H15 Dual on Shop···· hasn't shipped yet, Emilio. It's paid, and it ships November 14, 2026, along with the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA on the same order.

Nothing is needed from you in the meantime. You can follow the incoming shipments to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking goes to (email hidden) as soon as the label prints, so it's worth adding (email hidden) to your contacts in case our mail lands in junk.
I’m looking to cancel this order and get a refund please

I hear you, Emilio, and I know this hasn't been a smooth run with us.

On Shop····: your H15 Dual isn't sitting on a shelf. It's allocated to a unit being built for you, and what you paid has gone into manufacturing that specific unit. It ships November 14, about three weeks out.

Two things I can do without you losing a dollar: keep the full $985.49 as store credit on your account, usable today on anything in stock, or swap it to an in-stock miner.

Would either of those work?
Absolutely not I do not trust the customer service. If something is wrong with the new minor I don’t trust that it will be fixed or addressed at this time. I just want a full refund. Thank you.

That's fair, and I'm not going to argue it. Your PSU on Shop···· has been open since October 10 and you chased it twice. That's the part we got wrong.

I've held Shop····, so nothing ships while we sort this.

Before we go further: store credit isn't a commitment to another miner. It sits on your account at full $985.49 and waits, with no date and no shipping risk, until you decide you trust us again or never use it.

Would you take it on that basis?

I will not accept anything other than a full refund to my credit card. I will also be placing a dispute with my credit card company. If you keep declining to apply a full refund to my credit card as I stated before, I do not trust this company and do not wish to make any further purchases at this time
Handed to the team · Customer insists on a full refund to card and is threatening a chargeback; refun

Understood, Emilio. I've stopped pushing alternatives and put the refund request straight in front of Georges and Abel, who are the ones who process it. Nothing ships in the meantime, the order is held on both sides.

Please stay in this chat if you can, one of them will jump in here. If you step away, the answer comes to (email hidden)

I'm not going to promise an amount or a timeline myself, but they have the full picture, including the PSU that was never sent.

Thanks for waiting, Emilio. It's with them now and they're on until 6pm ET, so you shouldn't be sitting here long.

Nothing more is needed from you. The order stays held either way, and if you do step away the answer goes to your email.
